verdict.rationale: TeamViewer documents its own Web API, and its pricing page lists API access alongside auditability, so a programmatic surface exists. Nothing in the evidence shows how much of the UI that API covers, and probes found no machine-readable OpenAPI spec or llms.txt. Missing for 10: evidence of API coverage matching UI functions (sessions, device management, monitoring, remote scripting, AI features), a published OpenAPI spec, and independent or hands-on confirmation of parity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
